title: I Was Very Disappointed With This Laundry Basket
text:
I Was Very Disappointed With This Laundry Basket. As everyone knows, one star on Amazon means "I Hate It" ... and I hate this.

It is 2016 now and some manufacturers still insist on putting adhesive labels on products where it is impossible to peel off without leaving residue behind. On this laundry basket, there is a gigantic label that covers the entire inside bottom. It left behind adhesive crap that I needed to scrape off. Come on! This is ridiculous now. There is adhesive labels that leaves behind no residue...but perhaps this company doesn't wanna spend the extra money for it, even though they charge a lot for this basket.

Regarding the functionality of the basket: It is a bit difficult to push it fully open, and very difficult to compress it back down. Anyone with hands that have pain should not buy this. To collapse the basket back down, you need to do a lot of guiding/pushing/pressing all around the creases, on multiple sides. For the price they are charging, the expanding and collapsing should be a helluva lot easier than it is.
